Bash(node -e "const fs=require\('fs'\);const ar=JSON.parse\(fs.readFileSync\('js/i18n/locales/ar.json','utf8'\)\);const en=JSON.parse\(fs.readFileSync\('js/i18n/locales/en.json','utf8'\)\);function walkKeys\(o,p=''\){const r=[];for\(const k in o\){const np=p?p+'.'+k:k;if\(o[k]&&typeof o[k]==='object'\){r.push\(...walkKeys\(o[k],np\)\);}else{r.push\(np\);}}return r;}const enK=new Set\(walkKeys\(en\)\);const arK=new Set\(walkKeys\(ar\)\);const missing=[...enK].filter\(k=>!arK.has\(k\)\);const extra=[...arK].filter\(k=>!enK.has\(k\)\);console.log\('AR JSON: valid'\);console.log\('EN keys:',enK.size\);console.log\('AR keys:',arK.size\);console.log\('Missing in AR \(EN has, AR does not\):',missing.length?missing:'none'\);console.log\('Extra in AR \(AR has, EN does not\):',extra.length?extra:'none'\);")
